item.title: Firsthand destination knowledge is one of the most powerful assets a travel agent can build. FAM trips exist for exactly this reason, and Moiza Bertrand's Jamaica Carnival experience is a clear example of what they can deliver.
item.description:
Firsthand destination knowledge is one of the most powerful assets a travel agent can build. FAM trips exist for exactly this reason, and Moiza Bertrand's Jamaica Carnival experience is a clear example of what they can deliver.
Moiza toured five properties across Kingston and Ocho Rios, covering the full range of the Jamaica market from city-break culture in the capital to upscale resort experiences on the north coast. She returned with the confidence to match clients accurately to specific properties, speak to safety and local experiences with authority, and present Jamaica as a full destination rather than a single hotel booking.
Her reflection on the trip captures what we aim for across every agent development opportunity within JLT: "Seeing the properties in person has completely changed how I will sell Jamaica. I can now sell the destination as a full experience, not just a hotel stay."
Agent development built on real experience. This is how professional knowledge compounds.
Blog link to be added in comments after 24–48 hrs.

item.title: Niamh's Turkey FAM trip with Holiday Best
item.description:
FAM trips do what no training deck can: they put agents in a position to recommend with genuine confidence.
Our agent Niamh Considine returned from Holiday Best's FAM trip to Turkey having toured twenty-two hotels in six days. Properties spanned the full market spectrum, from budget and family resorts through to high-end luxury, with standouts including Berry Blue Resort, Belek Beach Resort, and NG Phaselis Bay.
When asked which moment on the trip she would return to, Niamh's answer was clear: "The NG Phaselis Bay site inspection."
Twenty-two hotels seen in person. That is twenty-two properties Niamh can now match to the right client, with confidence and firsthand knowledge behind every recommendation.
This is what the JLT supplier network delivers for our agents.
